sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' row 4 (#3 instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 4 (same check, wording 'stray paths')
evidence: Read the brief (instruction.md, 219 words) and all three note files (conversations.md 585, integration.md 249, walls-and-retention.md 653 words) in full. Spelling: every distinct word token across the four files was listed and inspected. No misspellings were found. Proper nouns (Kittle, Rowe, Harriet, Anand, Sian, Lloyd, Gwen, Pryce, Paul, Marsh) are spelled the same way everywhere and match seed_data.json accounts. Contractions (mustn't, we'll, I'm, I've, aren't, isn't, won't, doesn't) are correct. Contamination grep: TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|TBD|placeholder|<tag>|lorem|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|Documents|turing|worktree|judge|rubric|criteri|reward|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel. The only hits are ordinary prose: 'legal matter' (instruction.md:1) and the product word 'placeholder' for deleted messages (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:35). No author asides, draft markers or template leftovers (the template's 'CHANGE_ME' line is gone), and no paths from other machines. Every absolute path is a container path the environment actually provides: /assets/seed_data.json and /instructions are copied in by environment/Dockerfile, and /app is created there. The files contain no non-ASCII characters, no BOM and no CRLF, and each ends with a newline. No paragraph is duplicated. Contradiction cross-check: there is one clock, 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z (integration.md:7), which matches the seed 'clock' and app_context.md:27. There is one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11) with a single password, password123; it matches the five seed accounts and roles and app_context.md. There is one seed path, /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:5, integration.md:5). The timer options off/1/7/30 (walls-and-retention.md:23) match seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]. 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' (walls-and-retention.md:15) matches the seed M-12 walled list. The NODE_PATH, Express and better-sqlite3 claims (integration.md:3) match the Dockerfile. Port 3000 and DB_PATH match test.sh:108-109. I found no internal contradictions: author delete versus hold (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:29), the expiry boundary 'as old as' versus 'exactly seven days ago ... already gone' (walls-and-retention.md:23), and the signed-out rules (instruction.md:7, integration.md:9) agree with each other. Notes, not defects: (a) the seed earlier version 'Landlords notice recieved.' (seed_data.json, K-2 versions) is a deliberate typo inside the data, consistent with 'People fix typos' (conversations.md:9). It is not in the brief. (b) 'starting from /app/server.js' (instruction.md:5) could be misread as an existing file to edit, since /app holds only .gitkeep. integration.md:3 makes it clear that this is the entry point, and the same idea appears in the template ('The process starts from /app/server.js'). Any ambiguity belongs to row 6, not to contamination. Weak and conforming app probes: this row grades the text of the brief, not app behaviour, so no broken app can pass because of it and no conforming app can fail because of it. The checks are by source inspection only. The private check-instruction-hygiene.py and check-instruction-content.py were not executed; that deterministic half belongs to the deterministic reviewer.
